_what: What a failed or unsettled effect tells whoever acts next, read by src/failure.mjs effectOutcome for the tool-run owner (src/tool-run-owner.mjs, a run's effect_state) and the handoff effects ledger (src/agents.mjs recordEffect). Each row of `states` is one effect state: retryable says the same work may be asked again as it is, side_effect says what may have happened outside Trillion, required_next names the row of `next` that says what must happen first. A new state or a new next step is a row here; no code names one. `lock_while_unknown`: while an effect of a handoff is unknown (it may or may not have happened), the holder may only look: starting any further effect answers proceed false until a receipt from checking the target settles it or the person's next message in the conversation the work came from releases it (Muse 8.0, F-0244). The released effect stays unknown in the record, because that is still the truth, and is never started blindly again.

retry.said: It did not happen; it may be asked again.

check_target.said: It may have happened. Look at the target, then record what it shows; only reading is allowed until then or until the person says what to do.

run_again_with_key.said: It was never asked; run it again with the key it needs.

wait_for_computer.said: A computer took it and has not answered yet.
